## One portrait per club

Every club has a page with the figures from its statements, year by year: revenue, results, equity, debt and cash, with the caveats that apply and what is still missing. [See all clubs →](clubs/index.qmd)

## Where the numbers come from

From the financial statements the clubs themselves publish. Each value is read from the original document, checked by a second reading and tested against the balance sheet identity. What was adjusted, and why, is in [How we analyse](how-we-analyse.qmd). Errors found go to [Corrections](corrections.qmd).

:::
